name: Reign of Terror
body:
School necromancy [emotion, fear, mind-affecting]; Level cleric/oracle 9, legendary mesmerist 9, psychic 9, shaman 9, sorcerer/wizard 9, witch 9; Focus fear 9

CASTING

Casting Time 1 standard action
Components V, S

EFFECT

Range 60 ft.
Area 60 ft.-radius spread centered on you
Duration Instantaneous
Saving Throw Will partial; Spell Resistance yes

DESCRIPTION

You trigger a primal fear of horrors long gone from living memory in all enemies around you, sending the weak running for their lives. Each enemy in the area who fails its saving throw becomes panicked for as long as you are in its line of sight, and 1 round after that. Those who succeed on their saving throw are shaken instead. For 1 minute after the condition expires, if you enter an affected creature’s line of sight, they must attempt another saving throw, with the same results as though you’ve cast the spell another time. The conditions created by this spell are mundane, and thus cannot be dispelled. Magic that ends fear effects (such as remove fear) functions as normal.
